label: WhatsApp Fetch History (Baileys)
description: Fetch a WhatsApp chat's most recent messages (history is synced on demand). Each entry: `from`, `pushName`, `content`, `messageType`, `messageId`, `timestamp`, `fromMe`. A media message (audio, image, video, document, sticker) has its caption or null as `content`; get its bytes with BaileyFetchMedia.

inputs.name: bridge
inputs.description: The `bridge` output of the BaileyBridge node to talk through.

inputs.name: count
inputs.description: How many recent messages to fetch, a whole number of at least 1.
